apps/cloud/overview#fm.title: kombify Cloud
apps/cloud/overview#fm.description: What the hosted kombify account and dashboard are for, and what stays on your own hardware
apps/cloud/overview#b001:
kombify Cloud is the hosted account side of kombify. It holds your sign-in,
your subscription and the dashboard from which you open the kombify tools you
are entitled to.
apps/cloud/overview#b002:
kombify Cloud is in public beta. Availability is not guaranteed, and that
includes paid plans. Your statutory rights are not affected. See the beta
section of the terms on kombify.io.
apps/cloud/overview#b004:
- **Account and sign-in.** Sign-in, sign-up and account choice happen on
  kombify's hosted login page, powered by Auth0.
- **Dashboard.** After sign-in you land in the app at `app.kombify.io`, where
  you launch your tools and change settings.
- **Plans and billing.** Plans are billed through Stripe, monthly or
  quarterly, and you can cancel at the end of any billing period.
- **Households.** A household lets people you invite share items with each
  other. Availability follows the beta status above.
apps/cloud/overview#b006:
Cloud is optional for running your own infrastructure. A kit installed with the
[StackKits CLI](/stackkits/overview) works without a kombify account, and the
[Identity and Access concept](/identity/overview) explains how local and hosted
sign-in relate.
apps/cloud/overview#b007:
Sign up and open the dashboard.
    Change your plan or cancel.
apps/cloud/get-started#fm.title: Create an account and open the dashboard
apps/cloud/get-started#fm.description: Sign up for kombify Cloud and reach your dashboard
apps/cloud/get-started#b001: This page takes you from nothing to a signed-in dashboard.
apps/cloud/get-started#b003: You need an e-mail address you can read. Sign-up is open during the public beta.
apps/cloud/get-started#b005:
Go to `kombify.io` and start the sign-up. The page opens the hosted
    login with sign-up selected.
    Enter your e-mail address and choose how you want to sign in on the login
    page. All account steps happen there, not on a kombify form.
    After sign-in you arrive at `app.kombify.io`. Your tools and settings are in
    the dashboard.
apps/cloud/get-started#b007:
You are signed in when the dashboard opens at `app.kombify.io` instead of the
login page.
apps/cloud/get-started#b009:
Return to `kombify.io` and start the sign-in again. If the problem repeats,
use the Support page on kombify.io and name the time of the
attempt.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#fm.title: Change or cancel your plan
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#fm.descript: Manage a kombify Cloud subscription through the billing portal
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b001:
Subscriptions are billed through Stripe. You manage them in the billing portal
that the dashboard opens for you.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b003:
Sign in at `app.kombify.io`. List prices and the plans you can choose are on
the Pricing page of kombify.io. Every paid plan includes kombify Sites and
Paperwork Plus.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b005:
In the dashboard, open the account menu at the bottom of the left rail and
    choose the billing item.
    Compare Starter, Pro and All-You-Need, switch between Monthly and
    Quarterly, then choose a plan. Quarterly costs less than three monthly
    payments. The price is the same in EUR and
    USD. A launch offer, when one applies, is added at checkout.
    Finish the payment in Stripe's checkout. You return to the dashboard when
    it completes.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b007:
In the billing area, choose **Manage subscription** to open the Stripe billing
portal, then cancel there. The subscription runs until the end of the period
you already paid for.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b008:
Timing of other changes: an upgrade applies immediately and is charged pro rata.
A downgrade, a shorter billing period or a cancellation takes effect at the end
of the current period.
apps/cloud/plans-and-billing#b010:
The billing area shows your current plan and, after a cancellation, the date
on which it ends.
apps/ai/overview#fm.title: AI Guide and Workbench
apps/ai/overview#fm.description: How the kombify AI website, the Workbench and the Workbench desktop client fit together
apps/ai/overview#b001:
kombify AI is built around the Companion: one assistant that follows through
on what you ask. You reach it through three places.
apps/ai/overview#b002:
Companion Studio and the Workbench desktop client are in Alpha. Features, names and
availability can still change.
apps/ai/overview#b004:
| Place | Where | Needs an account |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI Guide | `ai.kombify.io` | No. You can read the product information and ask the Guide questions. |
| Companion Studio (web) | `workbench.kombify.io` | Yes. Sign-in uses the hosted kombify login. |
| Workbench (desktop client) | Windows app | Yes. It signs in through the same login. |
apps/ai/overview#b006:
Questions you ask the Guide are sent to the AI service without access to your
account or personal history.
apps/ai/overview#b008:
The desktop client holds no provider keys. Which models you can use is decided
by the server side of kombify AI, not by the app on your computer.
apps/ai/overview#b010:
The Workbench desktop client is a Windows-first control surface for local coding
sessions, with optional governed cloud endpoints. It is built on the open source
T3 Code project by T3 Tools, Inc. and credits it. Preview builds are unsigned,
so Windows may warn before you start one.
apps/ai/overview#b011: Sign in and start your first session.
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#fm.title: Open the Workbench
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#fm.descriptio: Sign in to the kombify Workbench in the browser
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#b002:
You need a kombify account. If you do not have one, create it first with
[Create an account](/apps/cloud/get-started).
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#b004:
Open `workbench.kombify.io` in your browser. The page is titled kombify
    Companion Studio; "Workbench" names the desktop client.
    Choose to sign in. The hosted kombify login opens. Sign in or choose your
    account there.
    You return to Companion Studio with your account. Ask your Companion for what
    you need.
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#b006: Companion Studio shows your account name instead of the sign-in prompt.
apps/ai/open-the-workbench#b008:
The Workbench uses essential cookies or local storage for sign-in, security,
theme, language and session handling. It works without any others.
apps/companion/overview#fm.title: kombify Companion
apps/companion/overview#fm.description: The kombify Companion apps for Android and iOS and their current state
apps/companion/overview#b001:
kombify Companion is the phone app that connects your kombify account, your
homelab and your Companion.
apps/companion/overview#b002:
Companion is a prototype in internal preview. There is no public store release
yet, and some features below are still being built. Installing it on your phone
is not possible for the public today.
apps/companion/overview#b004:
- A native app for Android and iOS that connects to kombify Cloud. Sign-in,
  sign-up and account choice happen on the hosted kombify login.
- A Feed that collects items for you in one place, with sections, a lane for
  items that need you, and settings for push notifications.
- Household sharing: send text, links, photos or folders to the people in your
  household.
apps/companion/overview#b006:
Feed and household sharing are under development and depend on the matching
Cloud features. They are not generally available. Check the current state of
the app on this page before you plan around them.
apps/companion/overview#b007:
Related: [kombify Cloud](/apps/cloud/overview) and
[AI Guide and Workbench](/apps/ai/overview).
